blocks.title: A Parisian breakfast
blocks.text: A croissant still warm, a café crème, a freshly squeezed orange juice. The set breakfast is €7 and served from opening time, 7 am: the right moment to watch Paris wake up before heading to the tower.

blocks.title: Macarons and the tea room
blocks.text: Pink velvet armchairs, marble tables, flowers everywhere. Settle in for a pot of tea, a café viennois or a box of macarons: raspberry, pistachio or vanilla.

blocks.title: Steps from the Eiffel Tower
blocks.text: About a 10-minute walk across the Champ-de-Mars. Dupleix metro station (line 6) is right next door, under the elevated tracks of boulevard de Grenelle.

faq.title: Before you come

items.a: No, just walk in. For a group, a birthday or a specific time, it's best to send a request on WhatsApp or call +33 6 95 13 46 56: the café will confirm your table.
From opening time, 7 am, Tuesday to Saturday. The set breakfast (pastry or bread and butter, hot drink and orange juice) is €7.
Yes: pastries, crêpes, plain or cheese omelettes, cakes and macarons. If you have an allergy, mention it when ordering and we'll tell you what each pastry contains.

items.q: Do you have a children's menu?
items.a: There's no fixed children's menu for now. A crêpe and a hot chocolate usually make little ones happy; just ask, we'll always find something.
Yes, it's something of a house tradition: cake, candle, table set up for you. Send your request a few days ahead with the « Birthdays » form; the café replies on WhatsApp.
The website and the menu are in French, English and Spanish. Travellers from all over the world come by every day: with the menu in front of you, we always understand each other.

items.q: Which payment methods do you accept?

faq.paymentUnknown: They'll be listed here very soon. If in doubt, call us on +33 6 95 13 46 56.

petitdej.title: Breakfast near the Eiffel Tower
petitdej.metaTitle: Breakfast near the Eiffel Tower, from 7 am | Café Louise Paris 15
petitdej.metaDescription: A real Parisian breakfast a 10-minute walk from the Eiffel Tower: croissant, coffee and orange juice for €7, omelettes and crêpes. From 7 am, Tuesday to Saturday.
petitdej.intro: From 7 am, before the queues at the tower: a croissant, a café crème and an orange juice, at 57 boulevard de Grenelle.

p: The €7 set breakfast is what Parisians have at the counter: a pastry (croissant or pain au chocolat) or bread and butter, a hot drink and an orange juice.
Hungrier? There are omelettes, served with baguette, and crêpes.

sections.h: From 7 am, before you climb the tower
p: The café opens at 7 am, Tuesday to Saturday. The Eiffel Tower is about a 10-minute walk away across the Champ-de-Mars: time to enjoy breakfast and still be among the first in line.
Dupleix metro (line 6) is 2 minutes away, La Motte-Picquet – Grenelle (lines 6, 8 and 10) 6 minutes.
A few terrace tables on the boulevard under the striped awning, and a pink and gold room inside, with velvet armchairs.
The café is closed on Sundays and Mondays.

salondethe.title: Tea room Paris 15
salondethe.metaTitle: Tea room in Paris 15, Grenelle and Dupleix: tea, macarons | Café Louise
salondethe.metaDescription: The tea room on boulevard de Grenelle: tea in a pot, café viennois, macarons and pastries, in a pink and marble room near Dupleix. Tuesday to Saturday.
salondethe.h1: A tea room in Paris 15, between Dupleix and Grenelle
salondethe.intro: Tea served in a pot, café viennois, macarons and pastries, in a room of pink velvet and white marble.

p: Pink velvet shell armchairs, brass-rimmed marble tables, fringed lampshades, garlands of flowers on the ceiling: the room was designed like a little Parisian salon.
Come on your own with a book, as a couple, or with the family for an afternoon treat.
Teas and herbal teas served in a pot, café viennois under its whipped cream, hot chocolate. Alongside: macarons by the piece or boxed, tarts of the day, cake by the slice and café gourmand.
Prices are on the menu, online and up to date.

At 57 boulevard de Grenelle, under the elevated metro, two minutes from Dupleix station and six from La Motte-Picquet – Grenelle. The Champ-de-Mars and the Eiffel Tower are about ten minutes away on foot.
